title: The Pricing matrices tab label carries a space before the count
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in as a user who holds the "Settings - Parts" permission, on the build under test. Open Settings -> Parts -> Pricing -> Pricing Matrices tab.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Pricing Matrices tab label exactly, including the spacing before the parenthesis.
  2. Compare N to the number of pricing matrices loaded for the tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The tab label reads "Pricing matrices (N)" with exactly one space between the label text and the opening parenthesis, and N is the total number of pricing matrices loaded for the tab.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
